title: Design System: slop-livin terminal UI (diffstat ledger)
note: Terminal (ratatui) surface, not a web app. No CSS/HTML DOM exists; components below are text-art/state snippets captured from committed frame fixtures in crates/tui/tests/frames/*.txt, verified against crates/tui/src/{model,ui,app,filter,units,actions}.rs as of the tui crate build (issue #34).

growth-green.usage: Bar fill and growth column when a row is net-growing (ui.rs bar_color).

shrink-red.usage: Bar fill when a row is net-shrinking; also the refusal footer line's text color. Never used as a background.

unchanged-dim.usage: Bar fill with zero net growth; the header line (whole line is DIM); the signals column text; the hidden-children count; the help overlay body.

marked-yellow.usage: The one and only yellow on screen: the row name (including its ✗ prefix) once Backspace marks it. Confirmed against marked_80x24.txt / confirm_80x24.txt fixtures.

selection-reverse.usage: Whole-line reverse video on the currently selected row; not a color swap.

monospace-body.purpose: The only font; every column (name, bytes, growth, bar, signals) is fixed-width and right/left aligned in it. No display/label distinction exists in this surface.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.effect: bar_width=8, name_width=38, signals collapse to first-glyph-per-signal (ui.rs draw_body)

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.effect: bar_width=24, name_width=60, signals join as a comma-separated phrase

motion.name: none-decorative
motion.purpose: No animation exists in the build. Bar and marked-row state update on the next render frame only; observing progress is a re-rendered percentage string in the header, not a spinner.

components.name: Diffstat row
components.description: One line: [rail][mark-prefix]name padded to name_width, bytes right-aligned width 10, growth right-aligned width 10 (human_signed_bytes, em-dash when no baseline), ▕bar▏ scaled to |growth| within the visible set only (never to size), then dim signals text.
components.notes: Verified byte-for-byte against tests/frames/projects_80x24.txt. Selected row applies whole-line REVERSED; marked row applies Yellow to name+prefix only, independent of selection.

components.name: Tree rail row
components.description: Worktree rows get ├─/└─ plus an expand glyph (▸ collapsed / ▾ expanded) computed by sibling position (last sibling gets the elbow). Child artifact rows nest one level under a │ or blank continuation prefix depending on whether their parent worktree was the last sibling.
components.notes: Verified against confirm_80x24.txt. Sort (g/s) is a no-op in this view on purpose (model.rs comment: reordering would break rail parent/child adjacency).

components.name: Header line
components.description: Single dim line: root path · observed <label> or observing… N% · since <window> (only present when the active filter is a bounded Growth filter) · N projects · attributed bytes · unowned bytes (docker-owned bytes excluded) · docker N unowned (separate figure).
components.ascii: /Users/dev/src · observed just now · since 1w · 2 projects · 9.9GB attributed · 200.0MB unowned · docker 5.0MB unowned
components.notes: The docker-unowned figure is subtracted out of the general unowned figure (ui.rs: unowned.saturating_sub(docker_unowned)), so the two numbers never double-count the same bytes.

components.name: Filter line
components.description: Editable line, prefixed '/' while editing or 'filter: ' at rest. On commit, a parse error keeps the previous Filter applied and renders inline in red past the typed text on the same row (no row is stolen from the body).
components.notes: Grammar as actually parsed (filter.rs): `growth [><] <size> in <duration>` (duration clause optional, defaults to unbounded), `kind:<k>`, `project:<name>`, `idle > <duration>`, `merge-complete`, and `0`/empty to clear. `idle` and `merge-complete` parse successfully but yield Filter::NoDataYet — the body then renders literally 'no data yet' — because no enricher backs them yet (#35). This is a real, shipped state, not a placeholder to hide.

components.name: Confirm banner
components.description: Inline one-line banner above the footer, not a modal: 'delete N unit(s) · <bytes> → Trash · Enter confirm · Esc cancel'. Enter on this banner is the sole human authorization point that drives actions::authorize -> execute_plan -> ledger.
components.ascii: delete 3 units · 1.9 GB → Trash · Enter confirm · Esc cancel
components.notes: Confirmed only reachable with marked.is_empty() == false; Esc/cancel clears confirm_open without touching marks.

components.name: Refusal footer
components.description: Replaces the footer for exactly 4s (REFUSAL_DISPLAY) in red text (never a red background) with 'refused: <reason>'. Refusal reasons are wired from two independent sources: units::markable (kind-level: git/source/loose/unknown are never markable) and the action layer's own sink recheck at execute time (e.g. ledger open failure).
components.ascii: refused: source trees are never a delete target
components.notes: The row stays and the mark clears on a mark-time refusal per DESIGN.md; verified against app.rs mark_refuses_non_artifact_kinds test and refusal_80x24.txt fixture.

components.name: Empty-result body
components.description: When the active filter yields zero rows: single line 'no rows match — Backspace to widen, 0 to clear'. Never a blank pane.
components.ascii: no rows match — Backspace to widen, 0 to clear

components.name: Help overlay
components.description: The only overlay in the product. Centered bordered box (Borders::ALL), title 'help (? to close)', listing the live key vocabulary and the filter grammar verbatim from the same strings the footer and parser use.
components.ascii:
┌help (? to close)───────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│Keys                                                                │
│  ↑↓        move selection                                          │
│  →/←       expand / collapse                                       │
│  Enter     open project / confirm delete                           │
│  Backspace mark selected unit for delete                           │
│  /         edit filter, Enter to apply                             │
│  0         clear filter                                            │
│  v, 1-5    switch view                                             │
│  g / s     sort by growth / size                                   │
│  ?         toggle this help                                        │
│  q         quit                                                    │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

narrative.northStar: diffstat ledger (unchanged from DESIGN.md; the build confirms rather than revises it)
narrative.overview: The five views (projects, tree, kinds, docker, unowned) all render one shared Report; nothing is computed only for the screen. The tree view is the one place a real hierarchy exists, so it alone gets the box-drawing rail and is deliberately exempt from g/s sort (reordering would sever the rail's parent/child adjacency). Every other view is a flat ranked list that g/s can reorder.

keyVocabulary.Enter: drill into a project (projects view) or confirm the pending delete (confirm banner open) — one key, two meanings gated by state (App::drill_into_selected)
keyVocabulary.Backspace (⌫): mark/unmark the selected row for delete, or refuse inline with a named reason (App::mark_selected)
keyVocabulary./: edit the filter line; Enter commits, a bad grammar string keeps the previous filter and shows a red inline error
keyVocabulary.v, 1-5: cycle or jump directly to a view (ViewKind::next / from_digit)
keyVocabulary.g: toggle sort by growth magnitude; pressing again toggles back to Sort::None (App::set_sort) — flat views only
keyVocabulary.s: toggle sort by size; same toggle-back behavior — flat views only
keyVocabulary.?: toggle the help overlay (the only overlay)

filterGrammar.growth [><] <size> in <duration>: duration clause optional (defaults to unbounded window); size units B/KB/MB/GB; duration units s/m/h/d/w
filterGrammar.kind:<k>: exact match against the kind_label the row already renders (build, deps, git, cache, source, docker-image, docker-cache, docker-volume, loose, unknown)
filterGrammar.project:<name>: substring match on project name, applied at row-build time
filterGrammar.idle > <duration>: parses; evaluates to Filter::NoDataYet (no enricher backs it yet, tracked as #35)
filterGrammar.merge-complete: parses; also Filter::NoDataYet for the same reason

stateMachine.mark: Backspace on a row with a unit+kind that passes units::markable toggles it into/out of App.marked (keyed by path string). A kind that fails markable() sets a 4s refusal instead and never touches marked.
stateMachine.confirm: Enter (when marked is non-empty) opens the inline confirm banner. Esc cancels without clearing marks. Enter again on the open banner is the sole human-authorization keypress: it drives actions::authorize -> execute_plan (per-unit, non-aborting on individual failure) -> ledger append, then clears marked and closes the banner regardless of per-unit outcome, reporting an aggregate 'N deleted[, M refused] · planned X · measured Y' in the footer.
stateMachine.refusal: Two independent sources feed the same 4s-red-footer mechanism: mark-time kind refusal (units::markable) and action-layer sink refusal at confirm time (e.g. ledger open failure) — both call App::set_refusal.
stateMachine.help: ? toggles help_open; it is rendered as an overlay on top of whatever view/state is current, never a separate mode that suspends input elsewhere.

narrative.actionLayerWiring: actions.rs is a thin driver, not new policy: MarkedUnit (path/bytes/observed_at) is enough to re-derive a slop_livin_core Artifact. authorize() mints a Plan and a Grant together for the same keypress (grant.created_outside_index = true, actor = the confirming human, never an agent or the index). execute_plan() calls slop_livin_core::execution::execute_delete once per unit, which does its own re-symlink_metadata + occupancy recheck immediately before the rename — the TUI does not re-implement sink safety. Every outcome is appended to slop_livin_core::ledger::Ledger. trash_root() resolves to ~/.Trash unless SLOP_LIVIN_TRASH_DIR overrides it for tests. free_space_bytes() via `df -k` is read-only and advisory: a failed measurement reports 'unmeasured' rather than blocking or fabricating a number. After execution the in-memory Report is locally patched (successfully removed artifact paths dropped from their worktree) rather than re-walking the whole root, which stays out of scope for this action.
narrative.buildVsDesignNotes: No divergence found between DESIGN.md and the shipped build for the four floor-review fix items (tree rail, g/s keys, header 'since'/docker-unowned fields, width-adaptive signals): all four are implemented exactly as DESIGN.md's grammar section already specified, confirmed against tests/frames fixtures at both 80x24 and 200x60.
